hero.title: Complete Custom Interiors
hero.sub: From 100% teak furniture to luxury sofa design and full office renovations, we bring artisan quality to every corner of your space.

services.title: Bespoke Sofa & Luxury Seating
services.shortDesc: Custom upholstery, premium foams, and luxury fabrics designed for ultimate comfort.
services.longDesc: We specialize in creating sofas that are more than just furniture—they are centerpieces. Using 32-40 density high-resilience foam and premium wooden frames, we ensure your seating lasts decades without losing its shape or comfort. Choose from over 500+ premium fabric options, from Italian velvet to durable linen.

services.title: Premium Teak Wood Creations
services.shortDesc: Authentic wood joinery for dining, bedroom, and living spaces.
services.longDesc: Our heritage lies in working with 100% pure teak wood. Unlike factory-made assembly line products, our pieces use traditional mortise and tenon joinery. Every dining table, bed frame, and wardrobe is built to be a family heirloom, cured to withstand coastal humidity and varying temperatures.

services.title: Commercial & Office Interiors
services.shortDesc: Functional, aesthetic workspace transformations for maximum productivity.
services.longDesc: Transform your business environment with ergonomic office furniture and modern layout designs. We provide complete turnkey solutions from reception desks to executive cabins and collaborative workstations. Scalability and durability are at the heart of our office designs, ensuring your professional space grows with you.
